Eleven individual self-catering cottages sleeping two to six, sympathetically converted from farm buildings around a shared courtyard.
Chaffinch sleeps four over two floors, with an en-suite master and twin bedroom, a large sitting room and a kitchen dining room. Pets welcome.
Cuckoo sleeps four, with a super king en-suite master, a twin bedroom, a large sitting area, kitchen diner and private patio. No pets.
Greygoose sleeps two, with a superking or twin bedroom, en-suite shower over bath, a large sitting area and a private patio. Pets welcome.
Mallard sleeps two, with a superking or twin bedroom, en-suite shower over bath, a large sitting area and a private patio.
Nightingale sleeps two, with a kingsize en-suite master bedroom, kitchen dining area, sitting room and patio. Pets welcome.
Partridge sleeps six, with a super king en-suite master, a king and a twin room, a family shower room and a large enclosed patio. Pets welcome.
Skylark sleeps two, with a mezzanine en-suite bedroom and spacious modern living, set in the corner of our courtyard. Pets welcome.
Swallow sleeps five, with a kingsize en-suite master and an en-suite twin room, a large sitting area and a patio. Pets welcome.
Swift sleeps six, with a kingsize en-suite master, two twin rooms, a family bathroom and a large sitting room. Pets welcome.
Woodcock sleeps two at the end of the run of cottages, with a superking or twin en-suite bedroom, large sitting area and patio. Pets welcome.
Wren sleeps two, with high ceilings, a spacious living area, a kingsize en-suite bedroom and a south-west facing patio. Pets welcome.
